newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Stals takes heart from fall in S.African inflation.
newsitem.headline: Stals takes heart from fall in S.African inflation.

text.p: South African Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals said on Wednesday he was encouraged by a fall in consumer price inflation in May.
"The rate of inflation that was released this morning is very encouraging," he said at a news conference, reacting to news that May year-on-year inflation rose 9.5 percent versus April's 9.9 percent.

"It has come down as we expected and what is more important is the figure for the month of May with the increase of 0.3 percent. Ignoring the seasonal influences, it is the lowest rate of increase we've had in any one month for at least the last 12 months."
A Reuters consensus poll of economists forecast a 0.6 percent month-on-month increase and a 9.8 percent year-on-year rise.
